clips_format.timecode_format_rules:
CRITICAL: All timecodes must be absolute timestamps of the ORIGINAL FULL VIDEO. Timecode format is strictly HH:MM:SS (hours:minutes:seconds). - start_timecode and end_timecode must both use HH:MM:SS - end_timecode must be later than start_timecode - do not return chunk-relative offsets
Examples: - clip from 5s to 18s -> "00:00:05" to "00:00:18" - clip from 1m 30s to 3m 45s -> "00:01:30" to "00:03:45" - clip from 15m 8s to 21m 12s -> "00:15:08" to "00:21:12"
